scope: Original topology, UVs, images and node hierarchy preserved; approved geometry, rest/bind and skin preparations declared per actor.

squirrel.preparation: Actor-specific shoulder/elbow guides, physical whole-forearm and paw fields, coherent face/abdomen and centered tail; inherited local channels and binds explicitly rebased.

dormouse.preparation: Raised anatomical shoulder guides and matching elbows, physical whole-paw fields, coherent face/abdomen and continuous socket/neck skin; centered native tail.

beaver.preparation: Anatomical shoulders, coherent face and abdomen, harmonic neck and whole-hock transitions; rump fur kept separate from the tail stem and rigid paddle; moderate supported-collapse head and tail turns.
